notes.title: Version 1.1 is released.
notes.content:
We fix the difficulty of the game, but hard to pass boss-fighting, enjoy it!

****UPDATE****
1. Change difficulty of level1 and level2.
2. Improve gatling gun.
3. Add background music in game.

****FIX****
1. Fix controller size.
2. Fix latency using electronic gun.

Hope you enjoy the version and feel free to comment this game :-)
